create_request_state: create a RequestState instance to manage GPU request scheduling with token buffers and staged writes
add_request_request_state: add a request to RequestState with req_id, prompt_len, token_ids, and computed token count
remove_request_request_state: remove a request from RequestState by req_id and return whether it was found
apply_staged_writes_request_state: apply staged writes on RequestState tensors to flush CPU buffers to UVA-backed memory
any_prefills_request_state: check if any requests in RequestState still have pending prefill tokens using an index mapping
